summary: DSC Holdings Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K with its second quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing includes revenue of RMB167 million (US$24.6 million), a GAAP net loss of RMB240.5 million due to IPO-related share-based compensation, and an adjusted net loss of RMB7.4 million. No special-situation transaction was announced; the press release is routine earnings disclosure. No deal terms apply. Investors should monitor quarterly performance and operating metrics for the used car platform.
